name: smithers
description: A personal email and calendar desk: your inbox split into what needs a reply, a 7-day calendar with multi-select delete, tasks, and a Compose tab. Claude Code reads your Gmail and Calendar through a local connector, writes a fresh overview of what’s ahead for the next seven days every time the app is opened, and parks drafted replies in Compose — you review and press Send. Claude never sends mail and never deletes events.
